name: pretrunc
description: Cut text at its start, middle or end to fit a width, measured before it paints, never overflowing. TypeScript core, Solid and React adapters.

paragraphs: Cut text at its start, middle or end so it fits a width, on one line or across N lines, measured before it paints. A cut never lays out wider than its box in Chromium, Firefox or WebKit. Try it in the demo.
pretrunc is before 1.0: a minor version can still change the API, and the changelog says how.
features: Small. The single-line core is 2.8 kB minified and brotli-compressed, with no dependencies. Multi-line cuts add 2.5 kB plus pretext, which only pretrunc/lines imports.
Fast. Text is measured once, then cut at any width by arithmetic: a resize re-cuts 5,000 rows in 1 to 3 ms. Middle cuts are 2 to 3 times faster than pretext's ellipsis demo cold.
Exact. It counts kerning beside the ellipsis, WebKit's dropped kerning at break opportunities, letter spacing, ligatures and joined scripts, and never splits a grapheme.
Steady. As a box is dragged, each end of a cut moves one way; the ellipsis doesn't flicker.
